verdict.description: BLOCKED iff at least one Blocker finding; otherwise PASS. Important/Suggestion findings do not force BLOCKED — /sprint disposes them at the wave gate.

summary.description: 3-6 sentence review summary: what the change set does, whether it conforms to the named design intent, and the overall quality judgment.

title.description: Short kebab-or-sentence title suitable for a FIXME filename.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding anchors to.

line.description: 1-indexed line number when the finding is line-anchored; null otherwise.

principle.description: Architectural principle cited by name/number from design/arch/principles.md; null when none applies.

target.description: Owning skill the finding should be routed to, per the /review cross-skill protocol.

detail.description: The finding body: what is wrong, why it matters, and what evidence in the diff or surrounding code supports it.
